definitions.source_backed: rows whose identity is a DBLP person-record DOI or title match, or a title quoted verbatim from the PI-named official profile or the official-profile-linked owned homepage (pi-publication-lists.json, page sha256 and quote per record); counted in distinct works (normalized title)
definitions.heuristic: rows credited through an OpenAlex author-id anchor and kept only because the byline shares 3 or more co-publications with the PI evidenced coauthors (coauthor-overlap rule); candidates, not source evidence, until a primary-source sample passes
definitions.held: rows flagged by the rules (uncorroborated anchors, books and chapters, non-SJTU affiliation, claim-held leaks); proposed or ingested holds, excluded from the kept counts
definitions.reviewed_openalex_id: rows credited through a reviewed OpenAlex author id (census override openalex) for the 8 PIs that passed the merge-risk screen; counted apart from source-backed

source_backed.definition: DBLP person record or page-quoted owned list

reviewed_openalex_id.note: 8 PIs bound by a reviewed OpenAlex author id with a merge-risk screen; per-work evidence is the id, not a record

sealed_package.note_stage5: main now marks 61 PIs reviewed no_identity; this package predates that mark and still carries their owned-list papers
